risk_reasons: Structural auto-approval candidacy is an invariant-#3 authority boundary: drift can allow a draft to auto-post or can bypass the intended owner-approval lane.
The pre-transaction candidacy result controls whether candidate-only database locks and migration-074 runtime-state reads execute.
goal: All structural Auto-approval call shapes derive candidacy and block reasons from one ordered gate table without changing which drafts may auto-post or which drafts take candidate-only database locks.
non_goals: Change any non-structural Auto-approval gate, trust-dial policy, moderation rule, subscription rule, tier rule, or veto-window behavior.
Change database schema, queries, feature-flag defaults, publishing behavior, or production configuration.
Refactor unrelated response-generation duplication from the Pathfinder report.
user_visible_behavior: A draft remains structurally eligible for Auto-approval only when AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED is true, origin_lane is live_ingest_new, version is 1, and suppress_notification is false.
Every structurally ineligible draft remains in the owner-review path with the applicable structural block reasons.
Structurally ineligible drafts continue to skip the businesses FOR UPDATE lock and Auto-approval runtime-state reads.
invariants: Invariant #3 remains fail-closed: no new input combination becomes structurally eligible for auto-policy approval.
The ordered structural reason vocabulary remains auto_approval_disabled, bad_origin_lane, unsupported_version, and suppressed_notification with each applicable reason emitted once.
The cheap structural boolean remains computable from environment and job inputs before sql.begin candidate-only work.
evaluateAutoApprovalCandidate remains the total evaluator and continues to apply every existing non-structural gate unchanged.
No dependency, schema, environment-variable, or externally visible contract is added.
edge_cases: Runtime disabled blocks every origin lane and version.
Null or any non-live_ingest_new origin lane is structurally blocked.
Every version other than exactly 1 is structurally blocked.
suppress_notification true is structurally blocked even when every other field is eligible.
Inputs failing multiple structural gates return all applicable reasons exactly once, and the total evaluator agrees with the blocked-decision form.
A fully eligible structural input still reaches candidate-only locking and runtime evaluation.
tests_to_add: property: structural candidate boolean, blocked decision, and total evaluator agree for every candidate-fields input
rollback_plan: Revert the structural-gates table and its consumers together, restoring the three prior hand-spelled predicates; no data rollback, migration, or remote flag change is required.
observability: Existing Auto-approval decision summaries and approval_audit_log rows continue to expose the evaluator outcome.
Existing mocked-SQL tests distinguish candidate-only businesses locking/runtime reads from structural short-circuit paths.
